dedupe_keys.name: aerosol induced plane of array irradiance loss and solar panel distribution in china 2001 2023 by power grid region

description: This figshare dataset by Pengxin Wu and Yan Li quantifies how aerosols reduced the solar resource for photovoltaic generation in China from 2001 to 2023 and how solar panel deployment interacted with that loss. Using satellite-derived irradiance and aerosol data, the authors find aerosols cut national mean plane-of-array irradiance (POAI) by 10.6 percent, up to 19 percent in the East and Central China grids, with sulfate dominant in most regions and dust in the north-west; a turning point near 2007 and the eastward shift of panels after 2013 are also reported. The files hold annual POAI and aerosol optical depth grids as NetCDF, power grid region shapefiles with annual POAI and aerosol fractions, yearly PV area by region, change decomposition tables as CSV and Excel, and figures. It is free to download under CC BY 4.0 and was published in September 2026. Coverage is China by grid region. Caveats: the deposit includes stray system files and duplicate copies, and results depend on the satellite products used. Simulation uses are aerosol-adjusted solar resource and panel exposure by grid region for capacity planning and air quality scenarios. Related records: data-chinapv-10m-2024 maps Chinese PV installations and data-jrc-pvgis-photovoltaic-geographical-information-system is a solar resource tool.
